newsitem.title: USA: Granite to acquire Detroit station.
newsitem.headline: Granite to acquire Detroit station.

text.p: Granite Broadcasting Corp said Tuesday that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire WXON-TV, the WB Network affiliated station serving Detroit, Michigan, for $175 million in cash.

Granite said that the addition of the Detroit station will increase the Granite station group's reach from almost six percent to about eight percent of United States television households and almost 80 percent of television households in the state of Michigan.
The company said it expects the acquisition, which is subject to approval by the Federal Communications Commission, to be completed during the first quarter of 1997.
